title: Measures to Detect Non-compliant or Modified Active Mobility Devices
what_it_is: Measures to Detect Non-compliant or Modified Active Mobility Devices

sections.label: Curbing non-compliant device inflow
sections.summary: Authorities work with Singapore Customs and ICA to curb inflow of non-compliant AMDs, and officers conduct daily enforcement operations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: First, we work closely with Singapore Customs, and the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA) to curb the inflow of non-compliant AMDs into Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Second, our enforcement officers conduct operations daily to enforce against non-compliant devices on paths, as well as retailers selling non-compliant devices.

sections.label: Penalties for first-time offenders
sections.summary: First-time individual offenders face fines up to $20,000 or up to 24 months' imprisonment, while retailers face fines up to $40,000.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Individuals who are first-time offenders are liable for a fine of up to $20,000 or an imprisonment term of up to 24 months, or both, while retailers who are first-time offenders are liable for fines up to $40,000.

sections.label: Regulations for online marketplace platforms
sections.summary: Tracking online sales is difficult, but regulations will be introduced for online marketplace platforms and shops regarding non-compliant devices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: As the Member has rightly pointed out, it is difficult for us to go after or to track what people are selling or buying online.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: However, we will be introducing regulations for online marketplace platforms and shops, in respect of non-compliant devices.

sections.label: Forfeiture and enforcement resources
sections.summary: Devices from unauthorised imports have been forfeited, and LTA will use technology and limited resources for enforcement operations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Yes, indeed, as said in my reply, we work closely with the Customs and ICA to curb the import of such devices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: In fact, we have forfeited devices that were unauthorised imports, whether by companies or individuals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Yes, I thank the Member for also asking for more resources for LTA to mount all these operations on the paths, in the public spaces to catch users or the use of non-compliant devices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: We will do our best with our limited resources.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: We will tap on technology, whether speed cameras, surveillance cameras, devices, tools to be able to help our enforcement officers to do their work better and more efficiently.
